# Bornholms Hospital

Bornholms Hospital is a healthcare organization located within [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]] [^src4]. It is specifically included in detailed hospital-level analyses for clinical quality indicators, notably meeting the standard for Indicator 1 [^src1]. The hospital's performance is systematically evaluated by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) to assess the quality of care for patients with atrial fibrillation.

In the reporting period from July 1, 2022, to June 30, 2023, Bornholms Hospital was measured against [[indikator-2|Indikator 2]], which tracks the execution of echocardiography for newly diagnosed atrial fibrillation patients [^src2]. The hospital achieved a compliance rate of 80.6% (95% CI: 73.6–86.4) for this indicator [^src2]. Additionally, the hospital's data is featured in broader regional and national evaluations, including metrics for anticoagulation treatment coverage (Indicator 4a), where it demonstrated high compliance rates, such as 92.2% (47 out of 51 patients) in one specific measurement period [^src3] and 91.3% (42 out of 46 patients) in another [^src4]. 

Through these detailed evaluations, Bornholms Hospital contributes to the comprehensive mapping of cardiovascular treatment quality across the Danish healthcare system, allowing for the identification of top and bottom performers at the local level [^src3].
